purpose: Pre-registered Cartesian grid for HV2 WNN sweep (HARKing-resistant per §3.5 safeguard #7). SHA of THIS file is pinned in aggregation_rule.json and recorded in every sweep results row.
input_adata_notes: READ-ONLY canonical v4.2 AnnData (8981 cells). Sweep computes fresh WNN graphs from X_pca + X_lsi; obs.seurat_clusters (n=14) is the reference labeling used in ARI evaluation; obs.leiden (n=53) is informational only.

weight_strategy_definitions.default: Seurat-style WNN per-cell modality weights derived from cross-modality kernel agreement (Hao et al. 2021 Cell 184).
weight_strategy_definitions.rna_weighted_2x: RNA modality contribution multiplied by 2 before per-cell normalization.
weight_strategy_definitions.atac_weighted_2x: ATAC (LSI) modality contribution multiplied by 2 before per-cell normalization.
weight_strategy_definitions.modality_kernel_balanced: Modality kernels rescaled so each contributes equal mean affinity prior to per-cell weight estimation.

knn_pruning_definitions.mutual: Edge (i,j) retained only if j ∈ kNN(i) AND i ∈ kNN(j).
knn_pruning_definitions.epsilon_0.5: Edge weights below 0.5 of cell-wise max affinity dropped.

harking_safeguards: This file MUST be SHA-pinned and git-committed on branch wave6-trevino-v5.1 BEFORE the first sweep configuration timestamp.
Post-hoc edits invalidate the sweep — verifier re-checks SHA at Stage H2-end review.
Any override (e.g., finer grid) requires NEW file + NEW SHA + NEW aggregation_rule justification — never silent extension.
